But the store is WAL-mode SQLite (packages/store/src/sqlite-event-store.ts:64) opened by other processes (agent-wrapper-main.ts:243, board-projection-service.ts:65, genesis-first-boot-worker.mjs:89), the selection authority already treats mid-read ledger movement as a refusal-worthy hazard, and the module's own doctrine (:14-18) is that agreement by coincidence is not a property.
